meta.title: WoW Forever Shaman spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to wowsims_overrides)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt does. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount (AP, mana, %) is floored.
formulas.tooltip_range: wowsims MinAt/MaxAt: base points +- |base|*variance/2 rounded half-to-even, plus the level gain, rounded outward. Checked against Wowhead's Forever tooltips (mythicsim test list, 25 Shaman rows): all within 1 point, 22 of 25 exact.
formulas.cost_pct_base_mana: cost = pct_base_mana/100 * base_mana(L) (base mana table in shaman_levels.json)
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank. Shaman trainers teach at that level; vanilla trainer data (cmangos npc_trainer_template 61) teaches on levels 1, 4 and every even level 6-60, which is the set of SpellLevels here. Per-spell trainer mapping was not checked (emulator trainer rows list teach-spell ids).

talent_taught.ManaTideTotem: Restoration tier 4 (rank 1 SpellLevel 1 = usable once the talent is taken); ranks 2-4 at 38/48/58
talent_taught.tier_gate: vanilla rule: talent tier N needs 5*(N-1) points in the tree, first point at level 10, so tier N opens at level 5N+5 (estimate for Forever: not checked in client data)

book_ranks_in_this_file.25357: Healing Wave Rank 10 - Tablet of Healing Wave X
book_ranks_in_this_file.29228: Flame Shock Rank 6 - Tablet of Flame Shock VI

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or any downrank coefficient penalty. Whether the Forever server applies one is unverified.
coefficient_penalties.client_data: The client rows carry unpenalized coefficients on low ranks: Healing Wave R1 (level 1) 0.429 = 1.5/3.5, R2 (level 6) 0.571 = 2.0/3.5, R4 (level 18) 0.857 = 3.0/3.5; Lightning Bolt R1 0.429, R2 0.571.
wowsims_code: resolve_spell.go: config.BonusCoefficient = damage.Coeff() (the client SPCoef, unchanged); spell_result.go adds BonusCoefficient * spell power. No level term anywhere in that path.

sim/shaman/ranks.go: const minRankLevel = 44, comment: 'In game a rank deals less damage once the caster is far enough past the level it is taught at; at level 60 a rank taught at 44 or later is clear of that.' TODO: cutoff believed 42 or 43. castableRanks() registers only Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and the shock ranks with SpellLevel >= 44. It avoids the effect by dropping ranks; it implements no formula.
sim/core/racials.go (Touch of the Grave): 'The drain takes no downrank scaling from a low-level trigger' - a comment only.
coefficient_penalties.mythicsim_code: docs/levels.md, Open: 'Spell coefficients below level 20: Classic scaled a low-level spell's coefficient down; whether Forever keeps it is unchecked.' src/prepare/spelldata/effect.rs uses only the per-level points; no coefficient scaling.
coefficient_penalties.in_this_file: sp_coef is the client value (what both sims use). Ranks learned below 20 also carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty, so the sim can switch the vanilla rule on. Neither sim applies it.

forever_vs_vanilla_notes: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and the shocks carry the 2-4 Nov 2026 retune (mythicsim hotfix_113554.rs lists the old values); Chain Lightning is 2.5 s, 0.714 coefficient.
Riptide has no initial heal in 70862 (E_DUMMY base 0); 12 s cooldown.
Windfury Weapon grants 2 extra attacks at 20% (passive 439431, 1.5 s ICD); Rockbiter grants attack power; Flametongue procs on every hit.
Lightning Shield and Water Shield hold 3 charges, 3.5 s ICD.
Healing Stream / Mana Spring totem rows last 300 s.
gaps: Riptide's removed initial heal: no Forever number exists to use; treat it as 0.
Rockbiter threat procs below the top rank (20860-20870) not extracted; wowsims uses 20871 for every rank.
Windfury Weapon: wowsims assumes every rank's enchant uses passive 439431 (20%, 1.5 s). The enchantment rows (misc 283/284/525/1669) were not read.
Talent tier unlock levels for Forever trees not confirmed from client data.

Effect 0 is E_DUMMY with base 0: the initial heal is gone in this build. Client 1.60.1.70425 had it as E_HEAL 480 (+3.7/lvl) on rank 1 and 841 (+4.9/lvl) on rank 3; Blizzard's 2 Nov 2026 notes removed it (mythicsim src/prepare/hotfix_113554.rs). Treat the direct part as 0.

Category cooldown 12 s (was 6 s in 70425); mana 150/180/230 (was 245/300/385).
wowsims does not implement Riptide (TODO in talents_restoration.go).

HealingStreamTotem.name: Healing Stream Totem
notes: The totem cast summons an NPC; the heal is the linked aura spell (RefIDs[0]): party area aura A_PERIODIC_HEAL every 2 s within 30 yd while the totem stands (300 s).
Tick heal has no level scaling; sp_coef 0.022 per tick (client SPCoef).
wowsims: registerHealingStreamTotemSpell is commented out (totems.go); mythicsim models it (heals.rs) with these rows.

ManaSpringTotem.name: Mana Spring Totem
notes: Linked aura: A_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE mana every 2 s to party within 30 yd, 300 s totem. No level scaling.

ManaTideTotem.name: Mana Tide Totem
notes: Restoration talent (tier 4); rank 1 SpellLevel 1 = available when the talent is taken (talent tier gate applies). Ranks 2-4 at 38/48/58. Rank 4 (1325256/1325257) is new in Forever.
Totem lasts 13 s, energize every 3 s -> 4 ticks of 88/133/197/290 mana to the party. 5 min cooldown.

WaterShield.name: Water Shield
notes: Restoration talent (tier 3, SpellLevel 20). One rank. No mana cost.

3 globes, 10 min. A hit taken, or one of the shaman's own spell crits (wowsims reading of the tooltip), spends a globe at most once per 3.5 s and restores 408511's 2% of MAXIMUM mana (E_ENERGIZE_PCT 2).
Mana per globe at level L = 0.02 * max_mana(L); no level term in the data.

LightningShield.name: Lightning Shield
notes: Forever rows: 3 charges, 10 min, ICD 3.5 s between orb discharges.

The shield's proc effect fires 26545 (a dummy, SPCoef 1); the damage spell is the rank's orb named in RefIDs[0] (wowsims shields.go reads Refs()[0]). Orb damage has no level scaling, sp_coef 0.267, cannot crit (wowsims).

Stormstrike.name: Stormstrike
notes: Enhancement talent (SpellLevel 40). Effects: normalized weapon damage, then 150% weapon percent damage (E_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE 150); A_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER +20% Nature damage taken from the shaman for 12 s, 1 charge (ProcCharges 1).
Cooldown 6 s (8 s in client 70425), cost 8% of base mana.

WindfuryWeapon.name: Windfury Weapon

effects.note_scaling: keeps scaling past 60 (max_level 68); at 60 it has gained 0 levels

notes: Each rank's cast enchants the weapon (E_360, misc = SpellItemEnchantment id, 1800 = 30 min).
The proc roll is the shared passive 439431: 20% chance (ProcChance 20) on main-hand melee hits, ICD 1.5 s. wowsims uses this passive for every rank (weapon_imbues.go).

On proc the rank's triggered spell (RefIDs[0]) grants 2 extra attacks (E_ADD_EXTRA_ATTACKS 2) with +AP (A_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, scales per level up to max_level) for those attacks. Vanilla gave 1 extra attack.

FlametongueWeapon.name: Flametongue Weapon

effects.note_scaling: keeps scaling past 60 (max_level 64); at 60 it has gained 4 levels

notes: Passive 436519 (ProcChance 100): every main-hand melee hit casts the Flametongue Attack.
Damage per hit (wowsims weapon_imbues.go newFlametongueImbueSpell) = proc.m1(L) * MH_swing_speed_s / 100 + attack.m1 (0), fire, sp_coef 0.1 (attack spell), can crit.
proc.m1(L) = the linked 'Flametongue Weapon Proc' spell's E_DUMMY value at level L (RefIDs[0]); attack spell = RefIDs[1] (29469, 29470, then 10444 for ranks 3-6).
Tooltip check: rank 6 at 60 is 2498+78*4=2810 -> 36.5 (1.3 s) to 112.4 (4.0 s) per hit.
